pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, jagged-edged polygonal regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients. Patch size is relatively large on the upper neck and mid-flank, transitioning into smaller, highly fragmented star-like geometries on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological web of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial, with pathway thickness narrowing significantly between the more fragmented patches on the posterior region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth 1D contour visible along the upper neck mane, composed of dense, upright hair clusters creating a jagged silhouette against the blurred background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textural disruption and hyper-pigmented nodular skin lesions are visible on the posterior/rump area, characterized by localized skin thickening and loss of clear patch/corridor definition.
